sourceRecords.title: Area 14 · Mormesk and the wizards’ quarters
read: Charred furniture stands beneath a sagging ceiling. A scorched chest waits beside a ruined bed. As you step in, darkness gathers out of the floor and turns toward you.

Charred furniture crowds the room beneath the damaged ceiling. The bed and chest survived the destruction well enough to recognize, though their contents cannot be judged from here. The dark presence near the floor draws attention away from them, making the threshold a useful place to stop and look.

brief: SAME scorched wizard's stone quarters. ONE dark incorporeal humanoid wraith Mormesk manifests above ruined furniture, ragged smoky form, menacing but no action against player characters. No solid living wizard, undead army, blue portal or visible treasure reward. Local lantern, scorched books remain.
